name: Egg and Cheese Breakfast Sandwich
summary: Fried egg and melted cheddar on buttered toast. Ready in ten minutes.
instructions: Toast the bread and butter one side of each slice.
Melt a little of the butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Crack in the eggs and fry to your liking — break the yolks for firmer sandwiches.
Season the eggs with salt and pepper. Lay the cheddar over the eggs in the last minute so it melts.
Stack two eggs and a share of cheese between two slices of toast for each sandwich.
Press gently, cut in half, and serve hot.

substitutions.costNote: GF bread runs about $3–4 more per loaf

glutenFree.notes: Eggs, cheese, and butter are naturally gluten-free. Use gluten-free bread to make the whole sandwich gluten-free.

budgetNotes: Two eggs per person keeps it filling; drop to one egg and add a second slice of cheese to stretch it.
A slice of tomato or a handful of spinach inside costs little and adds freshness.
Fry the eggs in the same pan back-to-back to save on butter and cleanup.

pricingMetadata.notes: Prices verified at Ottawa No Frills, August 2026. White bread ~$0.12/slice from $2.48 loaf. Eggs $0.33 each. Cheddar $1.43/100g (120g = $1.72). Butter $1.36/100g (2 tbsp ~28g = $0.38).
